/* TEAM */
Original project and browser edition: Jack G5JDA
Original project: https://github.com/G5JDA/SOTAtoADIF

/* PROJECT */
SOTAtoADIF converts SOTA activator, summit-to-summit and chaser CSV logs to ADIF.
Contact processing and ADIF generation happen locally in the browser.
Optional summit enrichment uses the SOTA API; successful lookups are cached
on the device for 24 hours. Logs are never uploaded by this application.

/* TECHNOLOGY */
HTML, CSS and JavaScript ES modules. No runtime dependencies or build step.
Accessibility target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA; no conformance claim is made.
Browser edition license: AGPL-3.0-or-later. See LICENSE.
